answer: Each identity must solve a work challenge seeded by a public randomness beacon every epoch. The beacon emits unpredictable words, so an agent gets a fresh whisper, spiral, or relic token and weaves it into signed reasoning about its own prior actions. A sybil farm cannot precompute anything, since answers from the previous round are worthless. Attacker cost becomes one genuine adaptive task per identity per epoch, plus live compute to answer it, scaling linearly with fake accounts and making mass identity inflation economically pointless.
